description: Hide a thread from your thread list until a time you pick, or a preset. Only your list changes: a teammate's is untouched, and a key snoozes for the member who made it. When the time comes it is back on top; a new message from someone else in it brings it back sooner. Snoozing again moves the time. Answers 400 snoozeOutOfRange unless the time is ahead of now and at most 90 days away. A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes can't do this on a thread that also holds mail from another mailbox: it answers 403 with `details.scope` `keyReads`.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

preset.description: later_today: in 3 hours. tomorrow: 8:00 the next day. next_week: 8:00 next Monday. Days and hours are the workspace's time zone.

until.description: When the thread comes back, an ISO 8601 date and time with its offset: in the future, and at most 90 days ahead. Pass until or preset, not both.

name: snooze_thread
title: Snooze a thread
